The statement incorrectly maps the value range (<=5) to the category range (>15), as there are several categories with values greater than 5. The claim should refer to the values for specific lengths, for instance, length 23 has 1 poem and length 50 has 1 poem. Also, the bar for title length 15 has a value of 1, not 4.
